traits.text: While in sunlight, the thrall has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 8 when perceiving by sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vampire thrall makes two Rapier attacks.

actions.name: Repay the Gift
actions.text: When a friendly vampire the thrall can see within 5 feet of it is hit by an attack that would reduce the vampire to 0 HP, the thrall can give some of its life force to save the vampire. The thrall loses 10 (3d6) HP, and the vampire regains HP equal to that amount.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Any critical hit against the dinosaur becomes a normal hit.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The velociraptor has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The velociraptor makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the velociraptor can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 4 (1d4+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Maul
actions.text: The velociraptor uses its claws to rip into one creature it is grappling. The target must make a DC 12 STR save, taking 10 (4d4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Virtuoso Lich
languages: Common plus up to two other languages

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If the lich fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its HP and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.text: The lich has advantage on saves against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.text: The lich doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.text: The lich is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Versatile Artist
traits.text: At the end of each long rest, the lich chooses one form of artistic expression, such as song, poetry, dance, fashion, paint, or similar. Until it finishes a long rest, the lich has immunity to one type of damage, which is associated with its artistic expression. For example, a lich expressing art through song or poetry has immunity to thunder damage, a lich expressing art through fashion has immunity to slashing damage, and a lich expressing art through paint has immunity to acid damage. This trait can't give the lich immunity to force, psychic, or radiant damage.

actions.name: Call Muse
actions.text: The lich uses Call Muse.

actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.text: The lich uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The virtuoso lich uses Corrupted Art. It then makes three Artistic Flourish attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Unrestrained Art (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.text: The lich unleashes the full force of its artistic talents. Each creature with 15 feet of the lich must make a DC 17 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 9 (2d8) damage of the type chosen with the Versatile Artist trait and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: Artistic Flourish
actions.text: _Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:_ +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 18 (3d8+5) damage of the type chosen with the Versatile Artist trait plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Move
actions.text: The lich moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Cast a Spell
actions.text: The lich uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Corrupted Art
actions.text:
The lich hums a discordant melody, paints a crumbling symbol of death in the air, performs a reality-bending pirouette, or emulates some other expression of corrupted or twisted art and targets one creature it can see, other than itself, within 60 feet. This action's effects change, depending on if the target is Undead.
- **Non-Undead.** The target must make a DC 17 WIS save. On a failure, a creature is blinded, charmed, or deafened (the lich's choice) until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated.
- **Undead.** The target regains 18 (4d8) HP. Healing that exceeds the target's HP maximum becomes temporary HP.

actions.name: Unrestrained Art
actions.text: The lich unleashes the full force of its artistic talents. Each creature with 15 feet of the lich must make a DC 17 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 9 (2d8) damage of the type chosen with the Versatile Artist trait and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The lich casts one of the following spells, using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

- **At Will:** _disguise self_, _mage hand_, _message_, _prestidigitation_
- **3/Day Each:** _charm_, _hideous laughter_, _hold_, _invisibility_ (self only)
- **2/Day Each:** _dispel magic_, _fear_, _dimension door_
- **1/Day Each:** _irresistible dance_, _programmed illusion_, _seeming_

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the war horse skeleton remains motionless and prone, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate war horse skeleton.

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.text: The skeleton doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.text: The skeleton is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Counterattack
actions.text: When a creature the war horse skeleton can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the skeleton can make one Hooves attack against the attacker.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Home in the Wilds
traits.text: The wild warrior automatically discerns true north when outside, and checks to follow its tracks in forest, grassland, hills, or mountain terrain have disadvantage, unless the wild warrior chooses to leave obvious signs of its passage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The wild warrior has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Quick Trap
actions.text: The wild warrior cobbles together a makeshift trap with materials at hand and throws the trap at a creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 DEX save or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spear
actions.text: _Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.text: The wood herald's Stealth is 18 while in any terrain with ample, obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Plant Resilience
traits.text: The wood herald is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

traits.name: Woodland Walk
traits.text: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the wood herald extra movement. In addition, the herald can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

actions.name: Brambly Bark
actions.text: When a creature the wood herald can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the herald can extend sharp brambles along its body, dealing 2 (1d4) piercing damage to the attacker.

actions.name: Slam

traits.name: Intuition
traits.text: The wyrdling rolls two dice for initiative, taking the higher number. In addition, the wyrdling has advantage on WIS (Insight) checks.

traits.name: Read Fate
traits.text: The wyrdling can spend 1 minute communing with fate on behalf of one creature that remains within 10 feet of it for the duration. The creature must ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. At the end of the minute, the wyrdling pronounces the result of the target's inquiry. This trait works like the divination spell, except it can't be used to answer a specific creature's question more than once every 3 days, regardless if the creature asks a different question.

actions.name: Call on Fate
actions.text: When the wyrdling is attacked by a creature it can see, it can pluck the strands of fate around the creature, imposing disadvantage on that attack roll. If the attack misses, the wyrdling or one friendly creature it can see within 30 feet of it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the attacker before the end of the wyrdling's next turn.

actions.name: Pronounce Fate
actions.text: The wyrdling pronounces the fate, either fortune or doom (the wyrdling's choice), of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target rolls a d4 and adds (fortune) or subtracts (doom) the number rolled to the next attack roll or save it makes before the start of the wyrdling's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Burst
actions.text: _Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 13 (3d6+3) psychic damage.
